connector.name: Twilize
connector.registryDescription: Generate Tableau .twb/.twbx workbooks: 47 tools for charts, dashboards, rules, CSV pipelines.
connector.summary: Hosted at web-production-dcbcb.up.railway.app over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the Python package twilize. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the subhatta123 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: PYTHONUNBUFFERED
env.description: Force unbuffered stdout so MCP stdio framing is never delayed by Python buffering.

env.name: PYTHONIOENCODING
env.description: Force UTF-8 stdio so non-ASCII content in workbooks survives the round trip.

env.name: MCP_LOG_LEVEL
env.description: Server log level. One of: debug, info, warning, error, critical.

env.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
env.description: Optional. Enables AI-assisted chart suggestions and reference-image styling.
